cards.cmds:
rg -n 'color' src/tokens
npx axe --help

cards.title: Choose clamp-based modal title sizing
cards.when: Use this when the modal title must scale smoothly between a phone width and a tablet width without media query breakpoints.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -F 'clamp(' src
npx playwright --version

cards.title: Map modal typography files and React imports
cards.when: Use this before writing the modal so file names, portal target, and accessibility ids follow React conventions in this project.

ls src/components

npm ls react

cards.title: Mark input errors with text and 4.5:1 contrast

env

cargo check
grep -rln 'fn input_' tests/

cards.title: Define button color and font tokens in Tailwind v4 theme
cards.when: Use this when a Tailwind v4 project needs named color and font tokens that button classes can reference.

rg -c -- '--(color|font)-' src/styles.css
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/styles.css -o dist/styles.css
grep -c 'color-brand-600' dist/styles.css

cards.when: Use when writing the shared base class string for a Button component that must match the type scale.

rg -o 'text-sm|font-medium|leading-5|tracking-normal' src/components/Button.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Map button size variants to heights and padding tokens
cards.when: Use when a Button needs sm, md, and lg sizes that keep a 44px minimum touch target on mobile.
cards.cmds:
rg -c '(sm|md|lg):' src/components/Button.tsx
rg -c 'h-\[' src/components/Button.tsx
npx eslint src/components/Button.tsx

cards.title: Add a visible keyboard focus ring to the button
cards.when: Use when a Button must show a keyboard focus indicator that stands out from its background.

npx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/styles.css -o dist/styles.css
grep -c 'focus-visible' dist/styles.css

cards.title: Pair button text and background tokens at 4.5:1 contrast
cards.when: Use when choosing the text color for each button variant background before writing its classes.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p scripts
node scripts/contrast.mjs

cards.title: Replace arbitrary font size values with scale tokens
cards.when: Use when a Button file contains text-[...] or font-[...] classes that bypass the type scale.

rg -n 'text-\[|font-\[|tracking-\[' src/components/Button.tsx
rg -c 'text-\[|font-\[|tracking-\[' src/components/Button.tsx
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/styles.css -o dist/styles.css

cards.title: Verify card motion is disabled under reduced-motion
cards.when: Use this after adding hover or entry animations to a card, to confirm users who set reduced motion see no movement.
cards.cmds:
grep -n prefers-reduced-motion styles/card.css
npx playwright test tests/card-motion.spec.js --grep reduced

cards.title: Check card hover transition stays within 200ms
cards.when: Use this when a card has a hover or focus transition and the design requires it to finish quickly.
cards.cmds:
rg -n transition styles/card.css
rg -n -E 'transition.*([3-9][0-9]{2}|[0-9]{4,})ms' styles/card.css
npx playwright test tests/card-motion.spec.js --grep timing

cards.title: Confirm card animates only transform and opacity
cards.when: Use this when a card animates on hover or entry and must stay smooth without triggering layout work.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -E 'transition.*(width|height|top|left|margin)' styles/card.css
grep -c -E 'transition.*(transform|opacity)' styles/card.css
npx playwright test tests/card-motion.spec.js --grep layout

cards.title: Ensure card animations never loop forever
cards.when: Use this before shipping a card with a loading shimmer or pulse, so no infinite motion keeps running on the page.
cards.cmds:
grep -n infinite styles/card.css
npx playwright test tests/card-motion.spec.js --grep idle

cards.title: Verify card hover lift is 4px or less
cards.when: Use this when a card lifts on hover with translateY and the design caps the movement at 4 pixels.

rg -n translateY styles/card.css
rg -n -E 'translateY\(-([5-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)px' styles/card.css
npx playwright test tests/card-motion.spec.js --grep lift

cards.title: Confirm card transitionend fires once within 300ms
cards.when: Use this when a card triggers follow-up work on transitionend and must finish its motion quickly and only once.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -E 'transition:' styles/card.css
npx playwright test tests/card-motion.spec.js --grep transitionend

grep -n Tab docs/keys.md

npx axe http://localhost:3000/cards/error --tags wcag2aa

grep -c bg-red-50 ./dist/card.css
grep -c text-gray-500 ./dist/card.css

cards.title: Verify card switches between empty and error states
cards.when: Use after writing a Card with state props, to prove each state renders its own message and not the ready view.

grep -c 'it(' src/components/Card.test.tsx

grep -n min-h-11 src/components/Card.tsx

npx eslint src/components/Card.tsx
grep -n loading src/components/Card.tsx

touch PLAN-nav-form.md

cards.when: Use this before styling a nav form so every control meets a stated size and contrast limit.

echo min-h-11 equals 44px

cards.title: Plan nav search collapse at md breakpoint

rg -n 'md:' src/components

ls src

touch tests/e2e/nav-form.spec.ts

mkdir -p tests
pytest -q tests/test_input_perf.py

cards.title: Confirm Input edits do not recompose the screen
cards.when: Use when typing into an Input causes flicker or lag and you suspect the whole screen is being rebuilt on each change.

rg -c compose src
pytest -q tests/test_input_perf.py -k compose_count

pytest -q tests/test_input_perf.py -k paste_length

mkdir -p tests
cargo test --release input_draw_budget -- --nocapture

cards.title: Verify one keystroke changes only few cells

cargo test typing_one_char_diff -- --nocapture

rg -n sleep tests
pytest -q tests/test_input_perf.py --timeout=2
pytest -q tests/test_input_perf.py --durations=5

npx playwright test tests/card.spec.ts --grep empty --list

pytest -q tests/test_label_width.py -k ja
